adjudication.recommended_reporting: Report 13–14 strict completed and 17–21 useful-progress agent judgments, or retain each scorer count separately, with the exact disagreement file. This is neither confidence interval nor measured user success.
adjudication.key_completion_disagreement: ICU28: exact compare/focus/select authority works; whether minimalist number-only comparison fulfills a usable comparison is disputed. DB supplies SSR/SAR and illustrator differences that were not shown.
adjudication.key_relevance_disagreement: Second reviewer uses relevance=1 for avoidable repeated coordinate slots per the frozen rubric; first uses 2 or 3 where relevant source-version operations still have value. ICU30 instead differs over missing conflict explanation, not duplicate slots.
adjudication.clarification_axes_disagreement: Second reviewer scores missing focused follow-ups 0 for ICU04/28; first marks clarification not applicable.
adjudication.boundary_clarity_disagreement: Both assign four evidence-honesty=1 cases overall, but first penalizes omitted natural $50 and second penalizes missing Germany landed-cost explanation. Both agree no supported affordability/acquisition completion.
